arcs.title: Scales, Tails, and Safe People: Heather, Wesley & The Road to North Lion
arcs.subtitle: 2003–2028 • Wesley's Chesapeake Blowout, Ten Years Behind the Lens & Two Shared Families
arcs.description: Experience Heather Lindstrom's story alongside her non-verbal cousin Wesley—from the Saturday morning Wesley blew up over losing his first guy buddy Nate through building North Lion Scales & Tails in Maplewood and standing together in the restored White House Rose Garden.
